headline: Australia Rethiinks Student Visa Rules as Enrolments Drop Threatens $1.4B
summary: Australia is recalibrating international student visa procedures after tougher assessments reduced enrolments and threatened to wipe $1.4 billion (A$2 billion) from public university revenues.
why: Higher education is Australia's largest service export, generating critical foreign currency revenues and supporting the broader services and housing sectors.

impacts.name: Australian Higher Education
impacts.why: Enrolment declines stemming from tight visa rules threaten A$2 billion in university revenue.
